title: 第9章 离开森林第10章 神阳剑诀
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
熔兵手是一门至刚至阳的掌法，以至阳掌力专破百兵，能够消融金铁。
刚才那一掌要不是安东留了手，罗曼的战斧早就化作一团烧红的废铁了。
现实中没有等级显示，安东也不清楚自己如今的实力究竟达到了哪个位阶。
但可以确定的是，在炼化出第二口太初灵气，又掌握了多门武技的当下，他的综合实力绝对不会比黑铁阶逊色。
对付一个白位中游，自然手到擒来。
罗曼在脑海里搜刮了一圈，始终没想起有在哪里听说过熔兵手这门战技。
银月氏族的战技传承以灵巧迅捷见长，从未见过像这样霸道刚烈的战技。
“这是谁教你的？”她忍不住问道。
安东微微一笑：“秘密。”
罗曼神色一滞，气得睁大眼睛瞪向他。
安东毫不在意，说道：“愿赌服输，你要帮我个忙。”
“......你说。”
生气归生气，但罗曼从来不是输不起的人。
她深吸一口气，将战斧扛在肩头，一副‘你说什么都答应’的豁出去模样。
“我之后有事要离开聚居地，如果有人问起，你想办法帮我遮掩一下。”
安东终于‘图穷匕见’。
离开银月森林外出狩猎，要是当天来回的话，时间未免太赶，效率太低。
可要是平白无故消失两三天，很有可能被人发现，这个时候就需要有人帮忙打掩护了。
这也是他在罗曼面前小露一手的缘故。
不给罗曼一颗定心丸，她肯定不会答应自己的要求。

“你要离开森林？”
罗曼听出了安东的意思，顿时面露愕然，却没太多反对的意思。
毕竟她自己也不是个循规蹈矩的人，因为违反规矩被处罚，也不是一回两回了。
比起违反规矩，罗曼更担心安东外出会遇到危险，但转念想到后者刚才展露的力量，到嘴边的话语顿时又咽了回去，神色变得格外复杂。
一直以来，她都觉得自己在战士道路上很有天赋，同龄人中鲜有敌手，却没想到安东深藏不露，不仅拥有超魔体质这种罕见的魔法天赋，在战技上也有着碾压她的实力。
甚至连兵器都没用，赤手空拳就击败了她。
难道这就是导师所说的，真正的天才？
“你离开森林是打算去......算了，你估计也不会告诉我。”
罗曼放弃了追问。
她太了解安东了，这家伙不想说的事情，怎么问都没用。
安东笑而不语，指了指罗曼战斧上的指印说道：“记得帮我保守秘密，也包括这个。”
罗曼撅了撅嘴，但最后还是点头道：“知道了，啰嗦。”
“谢了。”安东伸手揉了揉少女的脑袋。
他相信罗曼的承诺，这么多年青梅竹马的感情，这点信任还是有的。
或许是因为刚败在安东手里，罗曼没有像平时一样炸毛抗议，反而显得颇为乖巧，让安东好好过了把手瘾。
少女银白色的发丝柔软顺滑，带着阳光的气息。
手感绝佳。
回过神来，罗曼又提着战斧风风火火朝训练场赶去。
败北没有打击到她，反而激起了更强烈的干劲，她迫不及待想要加强训练提升自己实力。
content_en:
The Weapon-Melting Hand is a palm technique that is extremely strong and extremely Yang. The strength of the Yang palm is designed to defeat hundreds of soldiers and can melt gold and iron.
If Anton hadn't saved his hand just now, Roman's battle ax would have turned into a ball of red-hot scrap metal.
There is no level display in reality, and Anton doesn't know exactly what level his current strength has reached.
But what is certain is that after refining the second breath of Taichu spiritual energy and mastering many martial arts, his overall strength will definitely not be inferior to that of the black iron level.
To deal with a white midfielder, it's easy to catch him.
Roman searched around in his mind, but never remembered where he had heard of the Weapon Melter combat skill.
The Silver Moon Clan's combat skills are known for their dexterity and speed, and they have never seen such domineering and fierce combat skills.
"Who taught you this?" she couldn't help but ask.
Anton smiled slightly: "Secret."
Roman's expression froze, and he stared at him with eyes wide open in anger.
Anton didn't care and said, "I'm willing to admit defeat. You have to do me a favor."
"...you said."
Angry as hell, Roman was never a loser.
She took a deep breath, put the battle ax on her shoulder, and looked like she was ready to fight for anything.
"I have to leave the settlement for something later. If anyone asks, you can find a way to cover it up for me."
Anton finally found out.
Leaving Silver Moon Forest to go hunting, if you go back and forth on the same day, it will be too time-consuming and inefficient.
But if you disappear for two or three days without any reason, you are likely to be discovered by someone. At this time, you need someone to help cover you.
This was also the reason why he showed off his skills in front of Roman.
Without giving Roman reassurance, she would definitely not agree to her request.
"You want to leave the forest?"
Roman heard what Anton meant and was immediately shocked, but he didn't have much objection.
After all, she herself is not a rule-abiding person, and she is not punished just once or twice for breaking the rules.
Rather than breaking the rules, Roman was more worried that Anton would be in danger when he went out, but then he thought of the power that the latter had just shown, and he swallowed back the words that came to his lips, and his expression became particularly complicated.
She had always felt that she was very talented as a warrior and had few rivals among her peers, but she never expected that Anton not only possessed the rare magical talent of super-demon physique, but also had the ability to crush her in combat skills.
He defeated her with his bare hands without even using any weapons.
Is this what the instructor said, true genius?
"You left the forest with the intention of...forget it, you probably won't tell me."
Roman gave up questioning.
She knew Anton too well, and there was no point in asking him what he didn't want to say.
Anton smiled and said nothing, pointed to the fingerprints on Roman's battle ax and said: "Remember to keep my secrets, including this one."
Roman pouted, but in the end he nodded and said, "I know, it's long-winded."
"Thank you." Anton reached out and rubbed the girl's head.
He believed in Roman's promise, and after so many years of childhood sweethearts' relationship, he still had this trust.
Perhaps because he had just been defeated by Anton, Roman did not protest as usual, but appeared to be quite well-behaved, allowing Anton to get over his addiction.
The girl's silver-white hair is soft and smooth, with an air of sunshine.
It feels great in the hand.
After coming back to his senses, Roman rushed towards the training ground with his battle ax in hand.
The defeat did not dampen her, but instead aroused stronger motivation. She couldn't wait to strengthen her training to improve her strength.
